Scenes.Notes: After fighting through several Raiders inside the Concord Museum, the PLAYER enters a room, where he meets PRESTON GARVEY, who's standing guard, Laser Musket in hand, over a group of survivors. STURGES, one of the survivors, is busy working at a computer terminal.
The PLAYER has just rescued a group of survivors. Among them is GRANDMA MONK, who is quietly sitting on a couch. If DOGMEAT is there, she will mention how the brave dog went to go get them help.

Phases.Name: Player now knows about the Sight

Scenes.Notes: PRESTON GARVEY thanks the PLAYER for saving their lives, and asks him/her to come with them. Regardless of what the PLAYER says, GRANDMA MONK offers a word. She has seen the PLAYER's painful history through her gift of The Sight, and it has given her a clue as to where the PLAYER can find help locating his/her son.

Phases.Name: Skip If Player Already Finished MQ206

Scenes.Notes: The PLAYER approaches the Museum of Freedom. PRESTON GARVEY is outside on the second-story balcony, shooting at Raiders who are storming the area. As the PLAYER gets close enough, PRESTON GARVEY shouts at him for help.

The PLAYER tries to open the door to the room where the survivors are holed up, but the Raiders are still inside the museum. PRESTON GARVEY is forced to keep the door closed for fear that the Raiders might kill someone.

PRESTON GARVEY has just finished helping GRANDMA MONK down several flights of stairs. She is sitting on a bench in the lobby, and PRESTON is standing next to her. The PLAYER enters the lobby, having just defeated the Raiders and a Deathclaw outside, saving the survivors from almost certain death.

The PLAYER has just killed off all the Raiders in the museum. PRESTON GARVEY opens the door to the room where the survivors are holed up, and he beckons the player to get inside. The tone is urgent, but not desperate. This is a calm before the next storm.

Phases.Name: Preston must be in position, then open door

Scenes.Notes: As the PLAYER walks past GRANDMA MONK, she offers a dire warning about what's to come next.
After GRANDMA MONK delivers her prophetic words to the PLAYER, PRESTON GARVEY brings the conversation to a close, as he's eager to get the survivors out of the dangerous area.
